text: Landed on the person's 'Yes, fix the hook' (docs/ideas/20261119.md): the hook's command is now python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/contracts/validate.py" --quiet || exit 2. Run by this seat from the root and from meta_agent/src/build with the project's path set: exit 0 in both. The validator judges the repository it lies in, so no tree argument is needed. A session already open keeps the settings it started with until it is opened again.
